verdict.rationale: Text was extracted verbatim from floridarevenue.com guidance pages such as reemployment.aspx and rtlogin.aspx, and the probe describes the floridarevenue.com guidance as open, so the public reading surface appears reachable without keys. However, no probe records an HTTP status, user agent, or the absence of a bot wall, JS shell, or CAPTCHA on the guidance pages themselves. The only HTTP 200 with a standard UA was on the separate taxapps login shell. missing for 10: a direct probe of the guidance pages showing HTTP 200 with a standard identified UA, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA, bot wall, or JS-only rendering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: The Department has established an electronic file and pay program for entities submitting large data files with reemployment tax information.
The Department provides employers, agents, and employee leasing companies an application that allows a user to file their reemployment tax return electronically.
